a2a044b3c3a1dc05e276f59191869e5a739cc8d6: A resort on a human scale, Ancelle prioritises the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 30 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with family or for skiers who don't need to constantly renew their playground. Ancelle's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a good-natured atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Ancelle's moderate altitude — starting at 1,350 m, with a summit at 1,800 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly recommended. The day lift pass at €31 remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Ancelle suits those who want to enjoy a good week without the final bill knocking them off their chairs. In short: Ancelle is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincerely family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.

a2ed1075255920342bc514cdf1941b0d93a34eb6: A resort on a human scale, Bonneval-sur-Arc focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 32 km of runs are ideal for a 3- to 4-day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Technical terrain reigns supreme at Bonneval-sur-Arc: with 3 black runs and 7 red runs on offer, confident skiers will find plenty to challenge them. Off-piste and freeride are practised in often excellent conditions thanks to the altitude and the orientation of the slopes. As for snow reliability, Bonneval-sur-Arc is in a strong position with its summit at 3000 m — even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1800 m is also well placed to offer comfortable conditions from mid-December onwards. At €38 for a day lift pass, Bonneval-sur-Arc sits in the mid-range bracket on price — neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this rate for most skiers. In short: Bonneval-sur-Arc doesn't compete with the ski giants and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest, often underrated destination that deserves to be (re)discovered.
